note: 审美知识库——把'好看'标准写成可执行规则。type=vlm(自然语言检查) / pixel(像素检查)。source=来源（艺术原理/管线实践/用户反馈）。

rules.name: 三分法主体
rules.desc: 主体应落在三分线交叉点附近，避免正中心呆板
rules.prompt: Is the main subject located near rule-of-thirds intersection points (not dead center, not cropped at edges)? Rate 0-1.

rules.name: 主体完整
rules.desc: 关键部位（脸/手/头部）不应被画面边缘裁切
rules.prompt: Are any key parts (face, hands, head) cut off by the image edge in a bad way? Rate 0=no bad cropping, 1=bad cropping.

rules.name: 留白平衡
rules.desc: 画面留白不应失衡（主体方向应有呼吸空间）
rules.prompt: Is the negative space balanced? Does the subject have breathing room in the direction it faces? Rate 0-1.

rules.name: 空间层次
rules.desc: 应有前景/中景/背景的层次，避免扁平
rules.prompt: Is there clear spatial depth (foreground/midground/background layers)? Rate 0=flat, 1=good depth.

rules.name: 视角一致
rules.desc: 人物与场景的透视视角应一致（俯视/平视/仰视统一）
rules.prompt: Is the perspective consistent between subject and environment (all top-down, eye-level, or low-angle)? Rate 0=inconsistent, 1=consistent.

rules.name: 色调统一
rules.desc: 整体色调应统一（冷暖一致），避免东一块西一块（对应 M4 色彩统一）
rules.prompt: Is the color temperature consistent across the image (no clashing warm/cold zones)? Rate 0=mixed mess, 1=unified.

rules.name: 配色和谐
rules.desc: 主要颜色应和谐（互补/类似/单色系），无脏色冲突
rules.prompt: Are the main colors harmonious (complementary, analogous, or monochromatic)? Any muddy/ugly color clashes? Rate 0=clashing, 1=harmonious.

rules.name: 肤色自然
rules.desc: 人物肤色应自然不偏色（青灰/橘红过度都是问题）
rules.prompt: If people are present: is the skin tone natural (not greenish/gray/over-orange)? Rate 0=unnatural, 1=natural. No people = 1.

rules.name: 对比度正常
rules.desc: 对比度应适中——不灰蒙蒙也不死黑死白
rules.prompt: 亮度直方图：暗部/中间调/亮部占比均衡，无大面积死黑(<10)或死白(>245)

rules.name: 光源一致
rules.desc: 所有物体的受光方向应一致（同一光源）
rules.prompt: Is the light source direction consistent across all objects (shadows fall the same way)? Rate 0=inconsistent, 1=consistent.

rules.name: 明暗层次
rules.desc: 应有亮部/中间调/暗部层次（素描五调子的光影版），非扁平无体积
rules.prompt: Does the image have clear tonal range (highlights, midtones, shadows) giving volume? Rate 0=flat washed, 1=good volume.

rules.name: 无过曝死黑
rules.desc: 无大面积过曝（纯白无细节）或死黑（纯黑无细节）
rules.prompt: 计算纯白/纯黑像素占比，各 <5%

rules.name: 人体结构
rules.desc: 手/眼/肢体无畸形（多指/错位/比例崩坏）
rules.prompt: If people are present: are hands, eyes, and limbs anatomically correct (no extra fingers, no distortion)? Rate 0=broken, 1=correct. No people = 1.

rules.name: 透视正确
rules.desc: 物体透视无违和（桌角/建筑/平行线不乱）
rules.prompt: Is the perspective geometrically sound (no warped tables, buildings, or impossible lines)? Rate 0=broken, 1=correct.

rules.name: 表情自然
rules.desc: 人物表情自然不僵硬（除非是刻意表情包）
rules.prompt: If people are present: is the facial expression natural (not stiff, uncanny, or empty)? Rate 0=uncanny, 1=natural.

rules.name: 分辨率达标
rules.desc: 宽度和高度都应 >= 512（低于视为缩略图级）

rules.name: 无噪点模糊
rules.desc: 无明显噪点/涂抹/低清伪影
rules.prompt: Is the image sharp and clean (no noise, smearing, or low-res artifacts)? Rate 0=noisy, 1=clean.

rules.name: 无文字乱码
rules.desc: 无意外出现的文字/字母/乱码（对应 check-text 门禁）
rules.prompt: Rate 0-1 how much unwanted text/letters/numbers appear in this image (0=no text, 1=lots of gibberish text).

rules.name: 无画师签名水印
rules.desc: 无画师签名/水印/LOGO（商用/原创安全性）
rules.prompt: Are there any artist signatures, watermarks, or logos in the image? Rate 0=clean, 1=has signature/watermark.

rules.name: 风格统一
rules.desc: 画面内风格统一（不混搭：写实脸+卡通身体等）
rules.prompt: Is the art style consistent within the image (no mismatched realism/cartoon mixing)? Rate 0=mixed, 1=unified.

rules.name: 服装设计感
rules.desc: 服装应有设计感（层次/剪裁/装饰细节）而非基础款廉价感
rules.prompt: Is the outfit well-designed with fashion sense (layering, tailoring, decorative details) rather than plain/cheap basic clothing? Rate 0=cheap plain, 1=well-designed.

rules.name: 服装角色协调
rules.desc: 服装应与角色气质/体型/世界观协调
rules.prompt: Does the outfit suit the character's vibe/body/worldview (coherent design, not random mismatch)? Rate 0=mismatched, 1=coherent.

rules.name: 材质表现
rules.desc: 布料/皮革/金属等材质应有质感表现（光泽/褶皱/纹理）
rules.prompt: Are fabric/leather/metal materials rendered with quality (sheen, folds, texture) rather than flat plastic look? Rate 0=flat, 1=quality material.

rules.name: 配色协调
rules.desc: 服装配色应协调（主色+点缀，无脏色冲突）
rules.prompt: Is the outfit color scheme harmonious (clear main color with accents, no muddy clashes)? Rate 0=clashing, 1=harmonious.

rules.name: 鞋袜配套
rules.desc: 鞋袜应与服装风格配套（整体造型完整）
rules.prompt: Are shoes and socks/stockings visible in the image? If NOT visible, output 1.0. If visible, are they matching the outfit style (complete coherent look)? Rate 0=random, 1=matching.

rules.name: 记忆点辨识
rules.desc: 角色应有独特记忆点（剪影/色彩锚/符号/签名发型）——一眼可认
rules.prompt: Does the character have a distinctive memorable feature (unique silhouette, signature color anchor, iconic symbol or hairstyle) that makes them instantly recognizable? Rate 0=generic forgettable, 1=distinctive memorable.

rules.name: 设计统一
rules.desc: 服装/配色/世界观应统一——角色是完整设计不是拼凑
rules.prompt: Is the character a unified design (outfit, colors, and worldview elements coherent together) rather than mismatched parts? Rate 0=patchwork, 1=unified design.

rules.name: 裸露平衡
rules.desc: 裸露应有设计目的（点睛而非廉价）——克制优雅
rules.prompt: Is the skin exposure/body emphasis tasteful and purposeful (strategic accents like slits, straps, off-shoulder) rather than gratuitous or cheap? Rate 0=cheap exposure, 1=tasteful accent.

rules.name: 风格契合
rules.desc: IP/风格特征应到位（如方舟绑带/原神文化符号）
rules.prompt: If a specific IP/style was requested (arknights straps, genshin cultural motifs, military uniform), does the outfit clearly reflect that style's signature features? Rate 0=generic mismatch, 1=clearly on-style. If no style requested, output 1.0.
